properties.site-address: Proposal site E6 Site bounded by Luton Street, Bedlow Close, Capland Street and 60 Penfold Street, NW8 8RT
properties.notes: SHLAA. Demolition of buildings and redevelopment to provide two six storey buildings above lower ground and row of three storey townhouses comprising up to 168 residential units with ancillary facilities (Class C3) and a Sports Hall (Class D2), and associated car park, energy centre and all other works incidental to the proposed development.
